full_prompt_en: A square realist illustration shows an older bearded rider seated behind the front of a motorcycle against a plain warm off-white wall. The rider occupies the center and upper half, while large curved handlebars and metal lamps cross the lower foreground. His gray hair rises in a short central crest, and a full white beard spreads over his chest. Dark amber-tinted glasses cover his eyes, giving his weathered face a steady forward gaze. He wears a cream long-sleeved shirt beneath a worn brown leather vest decorated with small patches and metal pins. One forearm rests casually to the left, and the other stays near the machine, while bright red trousers form a broad warm area across the lower left. A round chrome headlamp sits toward the lower right, with smaller circular metal fittings at the left and a handlebar line running across his torso. The mechanical parts are densely observed, with highlights along curved chrome, dark gaps between components, and scuffed surfaces. By comparison, the pale wall is largely empty and lightly marked, allowing the layered rider and machine to stand forward. The image is painted with visible short strokes and textured color, particularly in the beard, leather, and metal, while contours remain firm enough to separate the parts. Warm daylight from the upper left brightens the face, sleeves, and chrome edges, leaving compact shadows under the handlebars and vest. The overall composition is direct and characterful, balancing pale negative space with richly worked brown, red, and steel-gray forms.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形写实插画，一位留白胡须的年长骑手坐在摩托车前部后方，背后是一面朴素的暖米白墙。骑手占据中央和上半部，大幅弯曲车把与金属车灯横过下方前景。他的灰发在中央竖起短短一束，浓密白胡须铺在胸前。深琥珀色镜片遮住眼睛，让饱经风霜的面容呈现稳定的前方目光。他穿奶油色长袖衬衫和磨旧的棕皮马甲，上面有小徽章和金属别针。一侧前臂随意停在左边，另一侧靠近机器，鲜红长裤在左下方形成宽阔暖色区域。一个圆形镀铬大灯位于右下附近，左边有更小的圆形金属部件，一道车把线横过他的躯干。机械零件经过密集观察，弯曲镀铬边上有高光，组件之间有深暗缝隙，表面带磨痕。相比之下，浅色墙面大体空白，仅有轻微痕迹，让层叠的人与机器向前显出。画面以可见的短笔触和带肌理色彩绘成，尤其表现在胡须、皮革与金属上，轮廓仍足够坚实以分开各部分。暖日光从左上方提亮面容、衣袖和镀铬边缘，在车把和马甲下留下紧凑阴影。整体构图直接而富于性格，以浅色负空间平衡刻画丰富的棕、红和钢灰色形体。
style_prompt_en: The realist painted treatment combines detailed focal surfaces with looser, visibly brushed surroundings. Warm off-white and ochre provide a quiet ground for leather brown, saturated rust red, charcoal, and cool steel-gray accents. Small opaque highlights pick out curved reflective edges, while granular strokes and scuffed patches make matte surfaces feel worn and handled. Hard mechanical contours interlock with softer fibrous textures, giving the central cluster varied edge quality. Directional warm daylight creates clear highlights and compact dark recesses rather than a uniform glow. The space is shallow and cropped close, with generous pale negative area helping dense detail remain legible. The overall feel is rugged, tactile, and slightly nostalgic.
style_prompt_zh: 这种写实绘画处理将细致的焦点表面与更松动、可见笔痕的周围环境结合。暖米白与赭色提供安静底色，承托皮革棕、饱和锈红、炭黑和冷钢灰强调。细小不透明高光点出弯曲反光边缘，颗粒笔触与磨痕让哑光表面显得经使用而有触感。坚硬的机械轮廓与较柔的纤维质地交锁，使中央密集团块具有多变边缘。暖调定向日光形成清楚高光和紧凑深色凹处，而非均匀发亮。空间浅且取景贴近，宽裕浅色负空间让密集细节仍易辨。整体感觉粗犷、可触，略带怀旧感。
theme_en: An older bearded rider seated behind a motorcycle
theme_zh: 一位留白胡须的年长骑手坐在摩托车后
name: David Mann
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
